supersedes.marking: SUPERSEDED - emission ticks were mislabeled as channel fates and gate-5 scope was not grounded

written_before: any seed search and any new panel result
is: instrument-defect closure, not a reopening of M2 or any C2 threshold

gate5_reground.c2_class: SAFETY-FAILURE = budget overrun, replay/mismatch RTT, duplicate RTT sample, authentication violation, DATA displacement, ARQ timer diff
gate5_reground.consequence: gate 5's DATA-displacement component is scoped to the WHOLE RUN, not a pre-Probe window
gate5_reground.withdrawn: the narrowing to ticks < first_probe_tick, which makes it structurally zero and silently redefines the frozen gate

pre_treatment_scheduler_equivalence.scope: prefix before the first treatment packet enters its directional channel
pre_treatment_scheduler_equivalence.requirement: traffic, event and channel digests exactly equal between arms

records: was a DATA eligible/queued at that decision point
did the Probe consume a pacing or budget opportunity a DATA would have taken
how many scheduler ticks was it deferred
was that DATA later sent or suppressed entirely
scheduler_data_displacement.claim_limit: proves only directly observed Probe-over-DATA arbitration; must not label long downstream trajectory differences as Probe-caused displacement

channel_fate_divergence.identity: DATA/source identity + transmission-attempt ordinal, from existing protocol identity; no new random or outcome-dependent matching

trajectory_divergence.scope: downstream traffic that cannot be matched

echo_bounded_rule: report 'N/A - NO ECHO'; never expand to a whole-trace horizon
positive_controls_non_vacuous: PC3 asserts probes_emitted > 0 AND the fixture tx equality explicitly; no silent conditional pass
PC4 asserts matched_fate_divergences > 0 AND the exact expected scheduler_data_displacement together
no-echo asserts echoes_arrived == 0 first, then echo_bounded_window == None
no-extra-packet asserts the entire directional event/fate trace is exactly equal
at least one fixture must PRODUCE post-treatment scheduler displacement and the oracle must be shown catching it
synthetic_control_limit: validates the oracle only; not evidence of product behaviour; never alters the shipping scheduler

withdrawn_claim.text: a treatment emitting <=3 probes cannot displace 380 DATA emissions
withdrawn_claim.correct: a few Probes can re-phase the shared GE state and, through pacing and ACK feedback, produce long downstream trajectory divergence; the old 376-382 figures remain non-authoritative because they used a u64::MAX horizon when no Echo arrived, not because of the probe count
